posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform OpenAI CEO Altman is now "pretty sure" AI is net job-creating, which is quite the pivot from predicting mass layoffs The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 1h ago • Altman reversed his earlier warnings about AI causing mass job losses, now claiming AI creates more jobs than it eliminates. • Both OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs are walking back dire employment predictions without citing new supporting evidence. • Existing studies have not yet validated either the original layoff predictions or the new job-creation claims.
